title: Schedule procedure runs and trigger them from monitors
description: No EventBridge schedule or event trigger references procedures; only inbound email reaches a procedure. Add schedules (cron per procedure, with limits) and a trigger when a monitor files a new reference (for example a new TTAB decision), with de-duplication so one source is processed once.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Monitor trigger built and live (2026-10-22). A router publication's procedureTriggers start a procedure once per source item after a delivery that created a new Reference: a TRIGGER# row written only if absent, an async invoke of the runner, and the runner's outcome recorded on that row. Enabled on MONITOR#ttab for Distinctive's distinctive.ttab.ruling-analysis (every new final decision). PRs #501, #509 ({documentUrl}). Still open in this task: cron schedules per procedure.
